[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Volik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], serving in [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as a heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]].
